Verdict: blockers on the headline reproducibility (the 194 number itself is right). A docs-only release PR, draft by design, held by the maintainer; no flag-ready, no review label, no cut. Not a merge approval.

## Blockers

1. RELEASE_NOTES.md:34-46 (the headline count). The stated rule does not reproduce. The notes say "194 pull requests merged since 0.27.0. 193 of them have their own merge commit in `git log --format=%s v0.27.0..release/v0.28.0` (a 'Merge pull request #N' subject). PR #4371 has no merge commit". The command returns 194 unique PR numbers, not 193, and ALL of them have merge-commit subjects. #4371 is NOT in the set. The notes present the git range as the source of the 193; it is not.
   - The range is also not "since 0.27.0": the tag v0.27.0 points at the merge commit of PR #4092 (the 0.27.0 release PR itself), and the tag is NOT an ancestor of main or of release/v0.28.0 (the main history is a different line). The range is "main at the branch base (5b52c5f8, 2026-11-26 01:03 UTC) -> release branch head". It includes 21 PRs that merged BEFORE the tag cutoff (2026-11-26T02:25:49Z): #2760 (2026-11-19), #3033 (2026-11-21), #3062, #3136, #3137, #3140, #3151, #3158, #3220, #3259, #3270, #3272, #3279, #3280, #3287, #3296, #3299, #3310, #3313, #3314 (2026-11-22) and #3674 (2026-11-25). It misses 20 post-tag PRs (#3986, #4057, #4065, #4067, #4068, #4070, #4071, #4074, #4077, #4080, #4083, #4084, #4089, #4091, #4097, #4099, #4104, #4105, #4109, #4129) and #4371.
   - The rule that reproduces 194: PRs merged into main with mergedAt >= 2026-11-26T02:25:49Z, excluding #4092 (the 0.27.0 release PR). `gh pr list --state merged --limit 500 --json number,mergedAt,baseRefName --jq '[.[] | select(.baseRefName == "main" and .mergedAt >= "2026-11-26T02:25:49Z" and .number != 4092)] | length'` returns 194. Exactly 193 of the 194 have a "Merge pull request #N" merge commit. #4371 does not: its merge commit is "Merge origin/main into issue/4341-retract-takeover" (8de6912e), and GitHub marks it merged because PR #4509 carries its head commits.
   - The classification of the honest 193 is CORRECT: 58 feat, 76 fix, 2 perf, 10 refactor, 18 test, 16 docs, 12 chore, 1 no-prefix (PR #3968). PR #4371 is one more fix (77 fix in the 194). The arithmetic in the notes matches the honest set; it is just not derivable from the stated git command.

## Minor items (ship as-is or fix at the cut)

- PR body, "What this PR does": "RECOMMENDED.md gets the 155 decision files of the cut under one `v0.28.0` heading." Actual: 154 files deleted from `docs/decisions/` (`git diff --name-status 2394b5ad1efc..d7f42e2c -- docs/decisions/ | wc -l` -> 154, all `D`). The v0.28.0 section of RECOMMENDED.md has 159 decision headings (`## #N`) covering 125 unique issues (e.g. #1120 appears 7 times, #1122 3 times). 155 matches none of the three.
- RELEASE_NOTES.md:139-145 ("Merged after the freeze"): the line "The maintainer also added #4410, #4449, #4423, #4424, #4368, #4441 and #4438 after the cut line." does not name #4462 (chore(process): PROCESS_VERSION 166, merged 2026-11-27T22:24:31Z, base main), which also merged after the cut line. The section is not an exhaustive post-cut-line list, but the one sentence that names the maintainer's additions misses it. The process-changes section (RELEASE_NOTES.md:309-315) documents 166's content and names #4449 and #4423; it does not name the bump PR #4462.

## Verified-accurate items

(a) The three findings of the earlier delta review (a893e1ad2) stay fixed:
- #4496 is in both the attention list (RELEASE_NOTES.md:183-186) and the "All open `P1` and `P2` issues" list (RELEASE_NOTES.md:200-202).
- #4472 is CLOSED (`gh issue view 4472` -> state CLOSED) and is NOT in the open lists; the red-main paragraph is present (RELEASE_NOTES.md:147-149: "The red `main` of the two `wire_post` tests (#4431, #4472) is fixed in this release by PR #4405"). #4431 is also CLOSED; PR #4405 merged 2026-11-27T23:23:54Z, title "fix(app): wire_post posts into a temp folder, not a fixed /tmp name".
- The version-166 process-changes line names PR #4449 and PR #4423 (RELEASE_NOTES.md:309-315).

(c) The classification sentence at RELEASE_NOTES.md:38-41 is reproducible from the titles of the honest 193 PRs: 58 feat, 76 fix, 2 perf, 10 refactor, 18 test, 16 docs, 12 chore, 1 no-prefix (#3968). Spot-checked, including the older PRs: #2760 fix, #3033 feat, #3062 fix, #3136 fix, #3151 feat, #3220 feat, #3259 fix, #3270 chore, #3280 feat, #3296 fix, #3310 fix, #3158 feat, #3617 feat, #3674 feat. #3617 (feat, 2026-11-27T02:46:09Z) is in the honest set; the 21 pre-tag PRs listed under the blocker are NOT.

(d) Known issues section: the attention list contains #4513, #4417, #4436, #4004, #4511, #4496, #4455 (all P1, 7 issues). The "All open" list has exactly 46 bullets and is identical to `gh issue list --state open --search 'label:P1,P2' --limit 200` (46 issues, same set). #4513 is in both lists. The stated rule excludes #4383 (open P2, the path kernel, out by decision) and #4312 (P6). #4092 (the 0.27.0 release PR) is not on the cut list and is a 0.27.0-era merge.

(f) The delta (a893e1ad2..d7f42e2c) touches only RELEASE_NOTES.md: 20 insertions, 8 deletions. Cargo.toml says 0.28.0; Cargo.lock carries 0.28.0 for the camcraft crates; the delta does not change Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock or CHANGELOG.md.

(g) The "Merged after the freeze" section: the seven freeze PRs merged 2026-11-28 00:01-00:02 UTC (#4467 00:01:57, #4298 00:02:00, #4442 00:02:05, #4425 00:02:09, #4458 00:02:12, #4459 00:02:15, #4460 00:02:19, all base main). The seven maintainer-added PRs merged 2026-11-27 21:45-22:54 UTC (#4410 21:45:03, #4449 22:08:13, #4423 22:08:21, #4424 22:08:17, #4368 22:08:25, #4441 22:54:49, #4438 22:54:53, all base main). #4509 merged 2026-11-28T08:34:18Z; #4371 merged 2026-11-28T08:34:20Z. No other PR merged into main between 00:02 and 08:34 UTC: the only candidate is #4497 (2026-11-28T04:34:09Z), whose base is side/path-kernel, not main. After #4509/#4371 nothing else merged into main.

## Not run

- No build: docs-only release PR, by design. No worktree, no target, no tests.
- No runner run: draft release PR held by the maintainer; no pr-test.yml run was started.
- No heavy lanes or gates: not required for a docs-only delta review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
